The called functions may throw runtime exceptions as per calls 1-4. However, the framework (likely Keycloak) typically has exception mappers that handle these runtime exceptions appropriately (e.g., mapping ErrorResponseException to HTTP 400, AuthenticationFlowException to 500, and other runtime exceptions to 500).
